import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String inp = scanner.nextLine();

        // Replace first 'at' with '@'
        int index = inp.indexOf("at");
        String modified;
        if (index != -1) {
            modified = inp.substring(0, index) + "@" + inp.substring(index + 2);
        } else {
            modified = inp;
        }

        // If string starts with '@', prepend 'at' and replace next 'at'
        if (modified.startsWith("@")) {
            int secondAtIndex = modified.indexOf("at", 1);
            if (secondAtIndex != -1) {
                modified = "at" + modified.substring(1).replaceFirst("at", "@");
            } else {
                modified = "at" + modified.substring(1);
            }
        }

        // Replace 'dot' with '.' and handle start/end dots
        if (modified.contains("dot")) {
            modified = modified.replace("dot", ".");
            if (modified.startsWith(".")) {
                modified = "dot" + modified.substring(1);
            }
            if (modified.endsWith(".")) {
                modified = modified.substring(0, modified.length() - 1) + "dot";
            }
        }

        System.out.println(modified);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
